content: We first look at the fairest comparison between mBERT and monolingually initialized RAMEN$_{\textsc {base}}$+BERT. The latter outperforms the former on five languages except Arabic. We observe the largest gain of +5.2 LAS for French. Chinese enjoys +3.1 LAS from our approach. With similar architecture (12 or 24 layers) and initialization (using monolingual or parallel data), RAMEN+RoBERTa performs better than RAMEN+BERT for most of the languages. Arabic and Hindi benefit the most from bigger models. For the other four languages, RAMEN$_{\textsc {large}}$ renders a modest improvement over RAMEN$_{\textsc {base}}$.
